FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 67
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/14/2024
House Bill 67 as introduced would repeal the current exemptions for certain computer hardware
and software from state bid law and would provide further for the awarding of contracts for
information technology supplies or services by sole source procurement. This bill would not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
